content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD flux-computation source file (header comment L3 mislabels it 'FILE main.F'; Simplified BSD license block L5-43). Driver SUBROUTINE FLUXES (L52) dispatches by HIGH_ORDER(1:3)=='FOU' (L56): fourth-order path calls CONSTRUCTION_HO (L67, Erduran et al. 2005 4th-order MUSCL-TVD with van Leer 3rd-order part and minmod 4th-order part) then WAVE_SPEED (L70); otherwise DelxyFun (L74), CONSTRUCTION (L75, 2nd-order piecewise-linear van Leer reconstruction per Zhou et al. 2001) then WAVE_SPEED (L76). Interface fluxes: if CONSTR(1:3)=='HLL' (L81) FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL (L82, HLL Riemann solver applied to P,Q,Fx,Fy,Gx,Gy via 6 HLL calls L126-131), else FLUX_AT_INTERFACE (L84, simple L/R averaging L104-109 for predictor); then BOUNDARY_CONDITION (L87). HLL (L143) computes upwind/star-region flux with SL/SR wave speeds (L151-162). DelxFun/DelyFun (L265/L211) compute van Leer limited one-sided derivative arrays with one-sided differences at domain edges (L247-251, L300-304). WAVE_SPEED (L324) uses Zhou et al. 2001 two-rarefaction estimates SxL/SxR, SyL/SyR over interior cells (L341-350, L376-385) and copies values into ghost cells (L352-373, L388-409). CONSTRUCTION (L424) builds L/R interface states via CONSTRUCT_X (L445-452) and CONSTRUCT_Y (L555-562), forms depths HxL/HxR=EtaR+Depthx (L454-455) and momentum/pressure flux arrays PL,PR,FxL,FxR,GxL,GxR,QL,QR,GyL,GyR,FyL,FyR with preprocessor branches CARTESIAN / ZALPHA / bare (L472-657); CARTESIAN+DISPERSION adds Boussinesq U4/V4 correction terms weighted by Gamma1 and extended masks MASK9u/MASK9v (allocated L435). CONSTRUCT_X/CONSTRUCT_Y (L731/L674) are 2nd-order reconstructions OutL/OutR=Vin±0.5*D*Din with Kappa argument retained but unused (comments L744-747, L688-691). CONSTRUCTION_HO (L1296) repeats the same flux assembly using 4th-order CONSTRUCT_HO_X/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y (L1503/L1618): first loop builds limited difference Din with triple minmod-style DVP1-3 limiting and dry-cell downgrades (MASK tests L1544, L1566; L1659, L1681), second loop applies van Leer ratio limiting (VAN1/VAN2 from RAT, L1577-1607, L1692-1722). CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L788) and CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod/CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod (L1017/L1135) are retained-for-test variants not called anywhere in this file (call commented out L63; history comments L783-785). Standalone limiter functions VANLEER_LIMITER (L1252) and MINMOD_LIMITER (L1268) close the earlier sections; their in-loop use is commented out (L239, L292).

unresolved: Header block says 'FILE main.F' (L3) but this file defines the FLUXES family; header appears copied from main.F — file-identity vs header mismatch.

Cross-line inconsistency: non-CARTESIAN FyL/FyR in CONSTRUCTION multiply Gamma3 twice (FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL*Gamma3, L621-622) while the same branch in CONSTRUCTION_HO uses a single Gamma3 (FyL=Gamma3*HyL*UyL*VyL, L1489-1490) and GxL (L548) also uses it once — likely leftover error in the L621-622 pair.

CONSTRUCTION_HO_minmod (L788), CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod (L1017) and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod (L1135) are not called by any active code in this file; the only invocation is commented out (L62-65) with history note that 4th-order+minmod is unstable (L783-785, L1012-1014) — dead code kept for tests.
Kappa dummy argument of CONSTRUCT_X (L731) and CONSTRUCT_Y (L674) is declared (L741, L684) but never used in the simplified bodies (comments L744-746, L688-690).
FLUX_AT_INTERFACE_HLL declares locals SR,SL,FL,FR,UL,UR (L124) that are never referenced in its body (L126-131).

CONSTRUCT_HO_X_minmod takes DX (L1022/L1024) and CONSTRUCT_HO_Y_minmod takes DY (L1140/L1142) but neither uses them in reconstruction formulas (L1115-1116, L1234-1235); active CONSTRUCT_HO_X/Y omit the grid-size argument entirely (L1503, L1618).

VANLEER_LIMITER one-argument form (A+ABS(A))/(1.0+A) (L1262) divides by (1.0+A) without the SMALL guard used at the in-line applications (L1580-1584); function itself is only referenced in commented-out lines (L239, L292, L222, L276).
In WAVE_SPEED the y-direction star velocity reuses variable U_S computed from V components (L381) — name inherited from x-branch; no separate V_S.
